free_text: The patient is a 74-year-old male with a significantly elevated PSA of 187.0 ng/mL and a prior biopsy showing Gleason 4+4 adenocarcinoma with perineural invasion. MRI demonstrated a PI-RADS 5 lesion with seminal vesicle involvement, classifying the clinical stage as cT1c. Given the high-grade disease and local extension, management requires a clinical review of individual treatment benefit against the risks of intervention.
